sector2.gml: var r = global.run; r.sector = 2; map_generate(); r.scrap = 187; r.fuel = 4; r.car.hull = 21; return r.sector;

reveal.gml: var r = global.run; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) { r.map.nodes[i].visited = true; } r.map.nodes[0].resolved = true; if (array_length(r.map.nodes) > 3) r.map.nodes[3].resolved = true; return true;

icons_ok.gml: var r = global.run; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) { var n = r.map.nodes[i]; var s = map_node_sprite(n, true); if (s != -1 && !sprite_exists(s)) return false; } return true;

every_fight_has_art.gml: var kinds = ["bandits", "robots", "corps", "insects"]; for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) { var n = { kind: "fight", faction: kinds[k] }; var s = map_node_sprite(n, true); if (s == -1 || !sprite_exists(s)) return false; } return true;

icons_centred.gml: var sp = [Spr_Icon_Map_Ants, Spr_Icon_Map_BOTS, Spr_Icon_Map_Bandits, Spr_Icon_Map_CORPORATE_, Spr_Icon_Map_Option_Here, Spr_Icon_Map_Shop, Spr_Icon_Map_Unknown, Spr_Icon_Map_You_are_Here]; var worst = 0; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(sp); i++) { var s = sp[i]; worst = max(worst, abs(sprite_get_xoffset(s) - sprite_get_width(s) * 0.5)); worst = max(worst, abs(sprite_get_yoffset(s) - sprite_get_height(s) * 0.5)); } return worst;

no_fuel_depots.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) if (nd[i].kind == "fuel") return false; } return true;

shop_share.gml: var shops = 0; var tot = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) { if (nd[i].kind == "start" || nd[i].kind == "exit") continue; tot += 1; if (nd[i].kind == "shop") shops += 1; } } return round(shops / max(1, tot) * 100);

fight_share.gml: var f = 0; var tot = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) { if (nd[i].kind == "start" || nd[i].kind == "exit") continue; tot += 1; if (nd[i].kind == "fight") f += 1; } } return round(f / max(1, tot) * 100);

shop_guaranteed.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; var found = false; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) if (nd[i].kind == "shop") found = true; if (!found) return false; } return true;
